gen-gf-bellota-text-fs-merriweather-sans: Distinctive and a bit commanding, Bellota Text draws its open c, e and s without any calligraphic shading to steer the eye. Merriweather Sans stands tall beneath it, its sturdy, large-looking lowercase the clearest difference between them.
gen-gf-bellota-text-fs-public-sans: Public Sans brings a hefty lowercase with broad open counters, and it comes across as trustworthy. And Bellota Text earns its keep big and brief, where its open, unshaded curves can show off.
gen-gf-bellota-text-fs-supreme: Chunky meets open: Bellota Text sets commanding, unshaded curves above Supreme, whose heavy-looking strip of text keeps every letter held open. Over many lines it reads crisp and steady, never curling shut.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-orbit: Bellota Text looks commanding, its open c, e and s shapes free of any calligraphic shading. Orbit keeps each character floating apart, with rope-like stems and bowls, so the two sit together without crowding.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-science-gothic: Science Gothic sets its stroke ends far apart and keeps every line uniform, so it feels approachable, one letter at a time. Bellota Text supplies the commanding, distinctive voice.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-syncopate: Spaced like rungs on a rope ladder, the body text reads with a technical pen's steadiness, under Bellota Text's commanding headings. Syncopate and Bellota Text both draw open c, e and s shapes, which ties them.
gen-gf-bellota-text-manrope: Bellota Text looks commanding and distinctive, its open curves left free of calligraphic shading. Manrope keeps a bright gap at each curve's mouth and one line width throughout, so extended text glides along.
gen-gf-bellota-text-montserrat: Bellota Text is the commanding one here, with open c, e and s shapes and no calligraphic shading. Montserrat, a geometric sans, floods each curve with white space and oversized counters.
gen-gf-bellota-text-satoshi: Bellota Text looks commanding and distinctive, with open c, e and s shapes. Satoshi's soaring x-height, wide-open e and uniform strokes hold up comfortably at a modest body size.
gen-gf-bellota-text-switzer: Switzer is all wire-like, tubular letters with a tall waist line. Bellota Text, commanding and distinctive with its open c, e and s shapes, gives them a counterpoint on the page.
